root_cause: Repository Writer Operational Verification was registered on every pull_request even though it admitted only verify/<writer>-* branches. Ordinary PRs allocated and skipped the workflow. The verifier also polled for a writer candidate up to 72 times at five-second intervals even though writer workflows now own event-driven immutable Shadow dispatch themselves.
prevention: Make Operational Verification workflow_dispatch-only with explicit writer/base/ref/SHA identity. Validate the execution ref and zero-overlap current-main drift, dispatch the real writer once in candidate mode, then terminate. Candidate creation and Shadow verification remain owned by the writer workflow; no polling or duplicate Shadow dispatch is allowed here.
